dismissed_comment: The pattern is the locally configured user regex from private ayuless_filters preferences; incoming messages are match input, not regex source. Regex syntax is an intentional filter feature. This does not assert that arbitrary user patterns are immune to excessive backtracking.

ContactsController builds this IN list exclusively from values escaped with DatabaseUtils.appendEscapedSQLString, including existing contact keys. The concatenated SQL does not interpolate unescaped lookup keys.

The ZIP entry name is reduced to the basename with lastIndexOf("/") before createFileInCache and only .txt entries are accepted. The output parent is the fixed sharing cache directory; ZIP directory components do not reach the output path on Android.

AnimationNotificationsLocker is a NotificationCenter animation lifecycle token, not a thread mutex. Release occurs in the animation completion/state transition callbacks (onAnimationFinish), intentionally outside the lexical scope of lock(). Reviewed the corresponding completion paths; this dismissal concerns the mutex model, not a general cancellation audit.

ProxySettingsActivity configures FIELD_PASSWORD with TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD and PasswordTransformationMethod before setting its saved value. This sink populates the masked local proxy password editor, not an external recipient.

MD5 here computes the Telegram encrypted-upload protocol fingerprint from the random 32-byte AES key and 32-byte IV, then XORs digest bytes. It is not password hashing or a standalone integrity check. Replacing this algorithm unilaterally would break protocol compatibility.
